title: Migrate dispatch service database from MySQL 5.7 to PostgreSQL 16
body:
The dispatch service still runs on a self-managed MySQL 5.7 instance, which is past end-of-life. Migrate it to our managed PostgreSQL 16 cluster.

**Plan**

* Convert schema and stored procedures; audit queries for MySQL-specific syntax
* Set up dual writes and a backfill job
* Run read-path comparison in shadow mode for one week
* Cut over during the Sunday low-traffic window
* Keep the MySQL instance read-only for 30 days as a rollback option

**Risks:** Dispatch is business-critical; any downtime blocks load assignment. Needs a tested rollback plan before cutover.
author: Abraham AIProject
